question: The records: which record controls title, and what gets booked
answer: This page follows the record, not the token: who books what, and whose record decides who owns it. It opens with the 3 process walks of how a trade, a payment and a fund subscription work today, and the debit-and-credit entries each party books at every step; then the steps-and-rights walks and transaction maps; the 17 asset traces (USDC from mint to redemption, BUIDL and others); the 7 accounting layers; the current U.S. stack; Securitize's 4 record models; DTC's records; the SEC transfer agent proposal; and 61 dated tokenization and clearing filings. A token, a chain or a software vendor books nothing by itself; only an entity whose own books hold the asset or the claim does.

rows.title: Buy a broker-held security
fields: Street-name cash equity. T+1. NSCC CNS. DTC participant file. Cede on the issuer register. NSS for bank cash.

rows.title: Step 1: Open the account
fields: A brokerage account is a relationship. Nobody has booked the security yet.
Seat: Investor · Today: Unnamed teaching customer · Overlap: A wallet is not this account · Overtake: No
Seat: Carrying broker · Today: Unnamed. LST on the NSCC directory only means the firm processes listed equity through NSCC — not that it is this trade’s broker. · Overlap: — · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 2: Trade date
fields: Buyer and seller (through brokers) take on obligations. The issuer and Cede do not move.
Seat: Investor · Today: Books a securities entitlement against the broker · Overlap: — · Overtake: No
Seat: Carrying broker · Today: Customer receivable / payable to the street · Overlap: — · Overtake: No
Seat: Venue · Today: Example: NYSE LLC. Trade may be internalized or another exchange. No $10,000 books of this trade. · Overlap: Securitize Markets is a different venue family · Overtake: No
Seat: Issuer / Cede · Today: No entry. Cede is already the registered holder. · Overlap: Token does not rewrite the issuer register · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 3: Clear
fields: NSCC novates. One long or short per member per security versus NSCC as CCP.
Seat: CCP · Today: National Securities Clearing Corporation (Rule 11 CNS) · Overlap: A token does not book NSCC’s receivable/payable pair · Overtake: No

Seat: Clearing member · Today: Full-service NSCC Member. Directory “CNS” is a muni preference, not this seat. LST = listed equity through NSCC. Examples (not this trade): BofA Securities; Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC has LST without the muni-CNS flag. · Overlap: Hidden Road is a DTC/FICC member — a different utility · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 4: Settle — securities and cash
fields: DTC’s participant file moves the security. Cash is not paid trade-by-trade: NSCC nets, DTC submits NSS, the Fed debits settling banks.
Seat: CSD / participant file · Today: The Depository Trust Company · Overlap: DTC tokenization can re-represent the participant entitlement. First phase is free of value. · Overtake: No
Seat: Nominee · Today: Cede & Co. still on the issuer register · Overlap: Saved design keeps Cede as registered holder · Overtake: No

Seat: Transfer agent · Today: Idle. Example: Computershare (2015 TA-1). If this register turned, it would be direct registration — a different process. · Overlap: Securitize is the BUIDL TA, not this equity’s TA · Overtake: No
Seat: Settlement agent · Today: DTC submits the NSS file for NSCC · Overlap: — · Overtake: No
Seat: NSS / Reserve Banks · Today: Federal Reserve Banks debit/credit settling-bank Fed accounts · Overlap: No chain confirmation is this credit · Overtake: No

Seat: Settling bank · Today: Member-designated. 47 banks on the 31 Aug 2026 public list (examples: JPM, BofA). List is eligibility, not this trade’s bank. · Overlap: Hidden Road is not this cash bank · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 5: Hold — three records of the same security
fields: Customer file at the broker, participant file at DTC, Cede on the issuer register.
Seat: Beneficial owner · Today: Investor’s entitlement vs the broker · Overlap: Wallet control is not this tier · Overtake: No
Seat: Participant record · Today: DTC file · Overlap: Token may reclass how DTC records the position · Overtake: No — same entitlement, different wrapper
Seat: Registered holder · Today: Cede & Co. · Overlap: Cede stays named · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 6: Service, exit, or fail
fields: A fail stays on the CCP/member/settling-bank waterfall. Issuer and wallet do not absorb it by default.
Seat: CCP on a fail · Today: NSCC receivable from the failing member remains · Overlap: — · Overtake: No

sections.part: 1 · How it works today, and what gets booked

rows.title: Make a dollar payment
fields: Fedwire Funds. Payer deposit at Bank A → Reserve Banks rebook reserves → beneficiary deposit at Bank B.

rows.title: Step 1: Identify the claim
fields: The payer holds a bank deposit. That is a different claim from USDC.
Seat: Payer’s money · Today: Deposit at the sending bank · Overlap: USDC is Circle’s liability, not this deposit · Overtake: No — different claim
Seat: Distributor · Today: — · Overlap: Coinbase has USDC distribution economics. Not the issuer. · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 2: Authorize the order
fields: Accepted payment order is still memo until funded and processed.

Seat: Sending bank · Today: Unnamed teaching bank. Example only: Payward Financial / Kraken Financial — Fedwire Funds only, use unproven. · Overlap: A wallet signature is not Bank A’s debit · Overtake: No
Seat: Reserve Bank service · Today: Federal Reserve Banks (OC 6 / Reg J) · Overlap: Idle until a dollar payout actually runs · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 3: Fund the sending bank
fields: A message does not supply reserves.

Seat: Sending bank · Today: Must have spendable funds. Kraken’s example account has no intraday credit. · Overlap: USDC mint moves Circle’s reserve assets, not this bank’s Fed account — and only on mint/redeem, not a holder transfer · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 4: The service transfer
fields: Fedwire always moves Bank A, the Fed, and Bank B. A USDC holder-to-holder transfer need not touch any of those books.
Seat: Sending bank · Today: Dr customer deposit / Cr reserve at Fed · Overlap: Idle on a token transfer · Overtake: No
Seat: Reserve Banks · Today: Dr liability to Bank A / Cr liability to Bank B · Overlap: No entry on a USDC holder transfer · Overtake: No
Seat: Receiving bank · Today: Dr reserve / Cr beneficiary deposit · Overlap: Idle unless a separate off-ramp · Overtake: No
Seat: USDC issuer · Today: — (not in this process) · Overlap: Circle Internet Financial, LLC still owes outstanding USDC; no entry on holder transfer · Overtake: No — never had this Fedwire seat
Seat: Messaging · Today: — · Overlap: SWIFT may coordinate a commitment. No $1m proprietary entry. · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 5: What the recipient received
fields: The receiving bank now owes the beneficiary a deposit. The payer’s invoice is a separate commercial entry.
Seat: Beneficiary · Today: Deposit at Bank B · Overlap: USDC holder has an issuer claim, not automatically a direct redemption right · Overtake: No — different claim

rows.title: Step 6: Exception or redeem
fields: Fedwire exception stays on bank/Fed books. USDC exit is inverse of mint, then this process for the dollar payout.
Seat: USDC issuer · Today: — · Overlap: Circle Dr USDC liability / Cr reserve cash · Overtake: No — this is a different instrument leaving, then Fedwire
Seat: Reserve owner · Today: — · Overlap: Circle Reserve Fund (~88% of year-end 2025 USDC reserves) · Overtake: No
Seat: Reserve manager · Today: — · Overlap: BlackRock Advisors, LLC (Circle fund only — not BUIDL’s IM) · Overtake: No
Seat: Reserve custodian · Today: — · Overlap: BNY for the Circle Reserve Fund. Separate from BUIDL custody and RLUSD custody. · Overtake: No
Seat: Payout bank · Today: Then Process C (Fedwire) again · Overlap: Unnamed. Do not assume Kraken, BNY, or Circle National Trust. · Overtake: No

rows.title: Subscribe to a fund
fields: Issuer-led subscription. Cash at the fund’s custodian bank. Shares on the transfer-agent register. BUIDL is the taught comparison.

rows.title: Step 1: Admit
fields: Application only. No cash, no shares.
Seat: Fund issuer · Today: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd. · Overlap: The BlackRock parent is not the issuer · Overtake: No

Seat: Transfer agent · Today: Securitize, LLC in the 2024 BUIDL appointment; current group name is Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC · Overlap: This is the overlap: a crypto-native TA on a BlackRock fund · Overtake: No — TA seat is occupied by appointment, not by replacing the fund; succession remains contract-specific
Seat: Placement · Today: Securitize Markets, LLC (BD/ATS) · Overlap: Not transfer-agent authority · Overtake: No
Seat: Investment manager · Today: BlackRock Financial Management, Inc. (2024 launch). Not BlackRock Advisors (that is Circle Reserve Fund). · Overlap: No subscription entry on the IM · Overtake: No

rows.title: Step 2: Funding
fields: Investor’s bank wires dollars. Custodian bank owes the fund a deposit. The fund credits capital.

rows.title: Make a dollar payment
fields: A bank-to-bank dollar transfer using Fedwire Funds

Beneficiary bank ↔ beneficiary: receiving account obligation

sections.part: 3 · Seventeen asset traces and the accounting layers

rows.title: 1 · Who owes whom?
fields: A customer deposit is the customer’s asset and the bank’s liability. A token representation does not automatically create a second independent claim.
Who is the issuer or debtor, and what exact right does the holder own?

rows.title: 2 · Custody & access
fields: Deposits, segregated custody and control of keys are different arrangements. Identify the asset holder, account provider and person authorized to move value.
Where is the value held, who controls it and who is allowed to instruct?

rows.title: 3 · Funding & inventory
fields: Funding confirmed before execution does not mean final settlement has occurred. Reservation, credit, collateral and prefunding carry different exposures.
What balance, credit or collateral supports the payment, for how long and at whose cost?

rows.title: 4 · Shared commitment
fields: A shared record lets relevant parties coordinate payment state. An informational record is not automatically a separate financial asset or the authoritative legal register.
What is authorized, recorded and executed; who can see it; what makes the commitment binding?

rows.title: 5 · Clearing & netting
fields: Matching agrees the obligations; netting calculates an offset amount under applicable rules. Neither alone supplies a settlement asset or guarantee.
Are obligations matched, netted, novated or guaranteed—and by whom?

rows.title: 6 · Cash & finality
fields: Customer credit, technical confirmation, cash settlement and legal finality can occur at different times. Identify which books discharge the obligation.
What asset settles the payment, which record controls and when is discharge final?

rows.title: 7 · Failure & remedy
fields: If the recipient can spend before banks settle and settlement fails, a contract and a balance sheet must carry the gap.
Who can correct or reverse, who bears loss, and what stress evidence exists?

rows.title: Securitize infrastructure anatomy
fields: Obtain or observe a public FINRA/BrokerCheck description that directly reflects the reported 2026 custody, underwriting and selling-group expansion.
Track production evidence and volumes for the NYSE digital-platform, Computershare and Continental relationships rather than treating partnership announcements as completed market migration.
Track BRSRV assets, supported chains, stablecoin-issuer use and network-outage or correction evidence separately from its launch.
Track the EU TSS opening, admitted instruments, members, settlement asset and production volumes separately from CNMV authorization.
Resolve product by product whether the official register is an off-chain control book, a composite blockchain-plus-identity register, or a linked incumbent register.

Securitize is best understood as a regulated securities-control plane rather than a blockchain or a general crypto-finance conglomerate. Its group joins transfer agency, broker-dealer and ATS functions, investment advice, fund administration, tokenization software and an EU trading-and-settlement venue while relying on outside issuers, asset managers, custodians, public networks and cash rails.

Group consolidation does not merge the licenses, appointments or duties of the named subsidiaries. A token can be part of an official shareholder register in one product, a representation reconciled to a transfer-agent control book in another, or a secondary layer attached to an incumbent registrar in a third.

The strategic asset is not a coin. It is the ability to keep the legal security, investor identity, transfer restrictions, official record, corporate actions, trading access and correction powers joined across several technical ledgers.

rows.title: Ripple and Securitize: two different control planes
fields: Ripple organizes the movement, custody, liquidity and enterprise management of money and digital assets. Securitize organizes the creation, ownership, transfer, servicing and correction of regulated securities. Their strongest fit is not duplication but a title-side and cash-side interface.

The two groups can meet in one transaction without merging their authorities. Ripple does not become the issuer or transfer agent for a fund share; Securitize does not become the issuer of RLUSD, a cross-border payment network, a prime broker for all assets or a corporate treasury-management system.
Title: Where they actually meet: BUIDL or VBILL to RLUSD

Steps: An eligible investor begins with a fund-share claim recorded and transfer-restricted through the Securitize-controlled product process., The enabled smart-contract functionality allows eligible BUIDL or VBILL shares to be exchanged to Ripple for RLUSD; the public announcement does not expose every intermediary book, price, mint/burn or bank-cash entry., The fund-share position must be cancelled, transferred or otherwise reconciled on the applicable shareholder record. A wallet transfer alone is not proof that this legal step completed., RLUSD is delivered as a separate stablecoin claim governed by its issuer and token terms. It is not the same asset or record as the redeemed fund share., Bank cash enters only if the holder later redeems or off-ramps RLUSD through an eligible route; neither announcement nor token delivery proves that bank payout occurred.

Proof state: The September 2025 release establishes an enabled RLUSD exchange option and planned additional integration. It does not publish route volume, a full accounting waterfall, universal XRPL use or evidence that Ripple controls Securitize's shareholder records.

rows.title: Where Ripple and Securitize fit into the GENIUS Act
fields: Enacted statute; core implementation remains proposed at this cutoff

GENIUS supplies the federal constitution for the payment-stablecoin cash leg. It reaches Ripple directly through RLUSD and Standard Custody's issuer obligation. It reaches Securitize mainly when a regulated security is funded, exchanged, settled, custodied or redeemed through a payment stablecoin.

GENIUS does not turn a tokenized fund share into money, authorize the underlying security, approve a blockchain, or merge the stablecoin issuer's ledger with the transfer agent's shareholder record. A named charter, current state approval or product integration is not by itself a GENIUS permitted-payment-stablecoin-issuer approval.

Steps: The investor holds a security whose eligibility, title, transfer restrictions and servicing are governed by securities law, product documents and the appointed recordkeeper., Securitize validates the investor and reconciles the security-side instruction; the fund share must be cancelled, transferred or otherwise reflected on the authoritative shareholder record., RLUSD is delivered as a distinct payment-stablecoin claim against its issuing entity. GENIUS governs the issuer, reserves, redemption, compliance and holder-priority architecture once operative., If the holder later redeems RLUSD, the issuer-side process extinguishes or reconciles the token claim and pays eligible bank cash under the applicable terms. That bank-cash receipt is another record, not automatic proof from the on-chain transfer alone.

Reading: GENIUS standardizes the money object at the handoff. It does not standardize the security, replace Securitize's shareholder record or prove that every announced exchange completed all accounting and cash-settlement steps.
A final OCC or other primary-regulator implementing rule and the resulting 120-day effective-date calculation.
Certification of New York's regime and a public approval naming Standard Custody, Ripple National Trust Bank or another exact entity as a permitted payment stablecoin issuer.
Any product-level evidence that a Securitize-administered fund or tokenized instrument is actually held as an RLUSD reserve asset, rather than merely being exchangeable into RLUSD.
The exact Securitize affiliate and stablecoin used in production atomic settlement, including customer, custody, order-control and accounting records.

rows.title: Who must pass the issuer gate?
fields: Standard Custody & Trust Company is the disclosed RLUSD issuer and current NYDFS-chartered obligor. To issue under the federal regime it must fit an approved state-qualified or federal-qualified route. Ripple's brand, software licenses and preliminary national trust-bank approval do not substitute for approval of the exact issuing entity.

Securitize is generally transfer agent, broker-dealer/ATS, adviser, administrator or technology provider around securities issued by outside funds and companies. It does not become the RLUSD issuer by offering the exchange interface.
The entity owing the dollar redemption is the regulated center of the GENIUS analysis, not the chain, wallet, transfer agent or brand alone.

sources.label: RLUSD reserve transparency and issuer description
Ripple National Trust Bank preliminary conditional approval

rows.title: What backs the cash leg?
fields: A permitted issuer must maintain identifiable reserves at least one-for-one in the statutory categories and meet redemption, disclosure, custody and supervisory requirements. RLUSD's disclosed short-duration reserve design is directionally aligned, but regulator approval and exact final-rule conformance remain separate findings.

A tokenized Treasury or fund share is not automatically an eligible RLUSD reserve asset. The statute can admit a registered government money-market fund invested solely in eligible assets and tokenized versions of permitted reserves, but actual eligibility depends on the exact product, portfolio, legal ownership and regulator treatment.
BUIDL or BRSRV proximity to Treasuries does not prove that Standard Custody holds that instrument in RLUSD reserves. A product receipt is required.

sources.label: RLUSD reserve transparency and issuer description

rows.title: Where can yield sit?
fields: GENIUS bars a permitted or qualifying foreign issuer from paying interest or yield solely for holding, using or retaining the payment stablecoin.

A separately constituted fund share can carry investment return because it is a security rather than the payment stablecoin. Exchanging RLUSD for a security, or a security for RLUSD, preserves two instruments and two claims.

Securitize can form a yield-bearing investment layer adjacent to a non-yielding stablecoin cash layer, but that is a legal separation—not evidence of an exemption, evasion route or automatic product approval.

rows.title: Who can freeze or correct what?
fields: The stablecoin issuer must have the technical capability to comply with lawful orders that can require seizure, freezing, burning or prevention of transfer of identified payment stablecoins or accounts. BSA, sanctions, customer-identification and due-diligence duties also attach to the issuer framework.

An appointed transfer agent can freeze, claw back, burn, reissue or correct the security-side shareholder record under the governing instrument. That authority does not let it rewrite Standard Custody's stablecoin liability.
Stablecoin control and security-title correction are separate remedy systems even when one interface coordinates them.

sources.label: Permitted payment stablecoin issuer customer-identification proposal

rows.title: How do the operating companies enter?
fields: Ripple Payments, Custody, Prime, Treasury or distribution entities can enter the analysis when an exact entity exchanges, transfers, safeguards, offers or sells a payment stablecoin for compensation. Their other products are not converted into stablecoin issuance merely because RLUSD is available inside the stack.

Securitize Markets or another exact affiliate can enter as a digital-asset service provider on the stablecoin funding, exchange, settlement or custody leg. The securities placement, ATS, transfer-agency and fund-administration legs retain their separate legal bases.
The 2028 provider gate will function like an asset-eligibility rule at covered U.S. intermediaries; application turns on the exact entity, activity, customer and coin.

sources.label: Treasury GENIUS issuance, offer and sale proposal
Securitize Q2 2026 results and operating update

rows.title: What happens if one side fails?
fields: GENIUS creates reserve-asset and bankruptcy priorities for payment-stablecoin holders and distinguishes the issuer's redemption obligation from a wallet balance or market price.

The investor's rights in the fund or equity security continue to depend on the issuer, governing documents and controlling shareholder record. A corrected share register does not itself produce dollars; a successful stablecoin redemption does not itself restore the share.
A failed combined transaction must be diagnosed leg by leg: security title, stablecoin delivery, stablecoin issuer claim and bank-cash payout.

rows.title: Repo Rates Blow Out; the New York Fed Steps Back Into the Market
fields: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

Overnight funding rates spike and the Desk restarts overnight repo operations against Treasury and agency collateral. The first crack in the old plumbing — the moment the Fed learned the dealer balance sheets could no longer carry the government's own debt market unaided. Everything after runs from here.
repo, New York Fed, Treasury market, liquidity

rows.title: March 2020: The Treasury Market Breaks Under Its Own Weight
fields: In the COVID panic the deepest market on earth — the market for the government's own debt — seizes. Dealers can't warehouse the selling. Official reviews of the wreck become the policy background for herding the whole market into central clearing. The mandate's origin story.
Treasury market, March 2020, market stress, central clearing

rows.title: Meme-Stock Week: NSCC's Margin Machine Bites the Brokers
fields: During the GameStop volatility NSCC's clearing-fund math produces huge intraday margin calls — the calls that made brokers shut off the buy button. The clearinghouse's discretionary premium charge, invisible to the public until that week, decides who may trade. A preview of what it means when one node holds the risk.

rows.title: The SEC Orders the Treasury Market Into Central Clearing
fields: The rule that starts it all: covered clearing agencies must make their members submit specified cash Treasury and repo trades for central clearing, and must wall customer margin off from house margin. The whole market for the state's debt, pulled into a handful of central nodes — by rule, on a clock.
Treasury clearing, mandate, SEC, FICC, margin

rows.title: CME and FICC Wire Their Margin Pools Together (Proprietary Cross-Margining)
fields: The futures house and the Treasury clearer let eligible members' offsetting positions — FICC-cleared Treasuries against CME-cleared rate futures — share margin. Competitors underneath, partners in the plumbing. The first bridge in what becomes a mesh.

rows.title: CME Quietly Incorporates a Brand-New Clearing House (CMESC)
fields: CME Securities Clearing Inc. is born in Delaware — a wholly owned subsidiary built to seek SEC registration as a Treasury cash-and-repo clearer. The mandate is already creating new institutions, not just changing old ones. No revenue, no members, just a charter and an aim.

rows.title: T+1: US Settlement Compresses to One Day
fields: The standard settlement cycle drops from two business days to one. DTC and NSCC rebuild their processing around the shorter clock. Each compression of the settlement day is another step toward the same destination: continuous, programmable settlement with no night in it.

rows.title: FICC's Own Survey: The Mandate Adds $4 Trillion a Day
fields: FICC surveys its sell-side members on what the mandate will do: more than $4 trillion of new daily clearing, roughly $58 billion of fresh margin, a possible $84.5 billion daily liquidity need. The clearinghouse publishing the bill for its own coronation.

rows.title: NSCC Starts Clearing Earlier — the First Stretch Toward the All-Night Market
fields: NSCC moves the start of trade capture roughly two and a half hours earlier. DTCC later names this the predecessor of the 24x5 schedule. The clearing day starts eating the night from both ends.

rows.title: SEC Approves FICC's House/Customer Margin Wall
fields: FICC may now calculate, collect, and hold member-proprietary margin separately from customer margin. The customer-protection scaffolding the mandate requires — before the crowd can be herded in, the pens have to be built.

rows.title: CMESC Files Form CA-1: A Second Treasury Clearer Asks to Exist
fields: Nine months after incorporation, CME's new clearing house formally applies for SEC registration to clear US Treasury cash and repo. The race for the mandate's volume begins in earnest.
CMESC, Form CA-1, registration, new CCP

rows.title: SEC Publishes the CMESC Application for Comment
fields: The Commission opens CME's clearing-agency application to public comment — File No. 600-44. The paperwork stage of building a second Treasury clearinghouse.

rows.title: SEC Extends the Treasury Central-Clearing Mandate: Cash Dec 31 2026, Repo Jun 30 2027
fields: The SEC's mandate herding all secondary Treasury-market trading into central clearing — in practice into FICC, DTCC's subsidiary — gets its compliance dates: cash trades by December 31, 2026, repo by June 30, 2027. The Commission says it does not intend further extensions. The whole Treasury market, one clearinghouse, on a clock.
Treasury clearing, FICC, DTCC, central clearing, mandate

rows.title: FICC Opens the Doors: Agent Clearing and Customer Segregation Go Live
fields: FICC switches on its enhanced Agent Clearing Service, splits proprietary from customer activity, and lets customers post margin straight to the clearinghouse. The access routes the mandate needs — millions of bilateral relationships, translated into standardized membership chains.

rows.title: DTCC's Great Collateral Experiment: Tokenized Collateral Moves Live on the AppChain
fields: DTCC demos its blockchain-based collateral platform live — tokenized collateral moving between major market participants in real time on its own AppChain, production targeted Q4 2026. Collateral velocity is liquidity; this is the deepest layer of market plumbing rebuilt as a machine, run by the monopoly depository itself.
DTCC, tokenized collateral, AppChain, blockchain, liquidity

rows.title: OCC Delays Ovation — the Options Monopoly's New Engine Slips
fields: The sole clearer of US listed options pushes back the launch of Ovation, its cloud replacement for the decades-old ENCORE core. Replacing the machine while it runs the whole options market proves harder than the brochure said.

rows.title: SEC Lets DTCC Move Core Clearing Onto the Public Cloud
fields: A quiet no-objection notice permits specified core applications serving FICC, NSCC, and DTC to migrate into a public-cloud environment. The market's central plumbing starts moving onto rented infrastructure — the concentration underneath the diversification.

rows.title: ICE Clear Credit Files to Clear Treasuries — the CDS House Wants In
fields: The dominant credit-default-swap clearer applies to add a Treasury cash-and-repo business: same legal entity, separate rules, membership, risk resources, and default waterfall. The post-2008 derivatives constitution, offered to the market for the state's own debt.

rows.title: SEC Publishes ICC's Treasury Application (File 600-45)
fields: The Commission opens ICE Clear Credit's Treasury-clearing application for public comment. Two challengers now stand in the docket against FICC's incumbency.

rows.title: FICC Files Collateral-in-Lieu: a Lien Instead of Margin
fields: FICC proposes taking a lien over the underlying repo collateral in qualifying sponsored trades instead of collecting separate margin or a sponsor guarantee. Making one unit of collateral do more work without losing legal control of it — the balance-sheet problem, solved by rewriting who holds what claim.

rows.title: FICC Proposes Agent-Cleared Triparty Repo
fields: FICC files to extend its Agent Clearing model to triparty repo processed on an agent bank's collateral platform. The clearinghouse reaches into the triparty world — where the settlement banks, above all BNY, hold the actual keys.

rows.title: SEC Approves CMESC: America Gets a Second Treasury Clearinghouse
fields: Twenty months from incorporation to registration — CME Securities Clearing is approved as a clearing agency for US Treasury securities. CME announces a Q2 2026 launch. For the first time since the mandate, FICC has a licensed rival.

rows.title: SEC No-Action Letter: DTC May Tokenize US Securities
fields: By staff letter — not rulemaking — the SEC authorizes DTC, custodian of $114 trillion, to tokenize Russell 1000 stocks, major ETFs, and Treasury bills, notes and bonds on pre-approved blockchains for three years, tokens carrying full legal entitlements. The letter flags future corporate-action payouts in stablecoins or tokenized deposits. The moment the state blessed putting the national securities register on-chain.
DTC, tokenization, no-action letter, $114 trillion, stablecoin distributions

rows.title: SEC Approves Collateral-in-Lieu: FICC May Take the Lien
fields: Approved: FICC can accept a lien on qualifying repo collateral in lieu of margin, and sponsored general-collateral trades can be done away from the sponsor. The collateral machinery of the new Treasury market clicks into place, one filing at a time.

rows.title: DTCC and Digital Asset to Tokenize DTC-Custodied Treasuries on Canton
fields: Six days after the SEC's no-action letter, DTCC names its first rail for the national debt: DTC-custodied US Treasury securities to be tokenized on the Canton network with Digital Asset. The Treasuries side of the register picks its blockchain.
DTCC, Canton, Treasuries, tokenization, Digital Asset

rows.title: OCC: Ovation Testing to Resume Q2 2026
fields: After a half-year pause, OCC says external testing of its new core will reopen in the second quarter of 2026. The riskiest single platform replacement in the American market structure inches forward.

rows.title: NSCC Opens Industry Testing for the All-Night Market
fields: The 24x5 test environment opens. Firms consuming real-time trade messages must test the new business-date field whether they mean to trade overnight or not — when the clearing layer changes its clock, everyone downstream changes with it.

rows.title: CMESC's Board Writes the Member-Risk Rules
fields: The new clearinghouse's board approves the first tranche of rules on members' contractual rights, liens on user margin, and closing out a user's positions. Who may enter, who holds the lien, who gets closed out — the loss waterfall is the constitution, and it is being drafted.

rows.title: ICC Publishes Its Treasury Clearing Rulebook
fields: The CDS house issues Treasury Clearing Rules: separate governance, margin, guaranty fund, and default management for the new business. Two-day margin period of risk, Monte Carlo VaR, a Cover-2 participant fund, $100 million of ICC's own skin. The constitution of the second waterfall, in print.
ICC, rulebook, guaranty fund, default waterfall

rows.title: CMESC Files Its Enterprise-Risk Framework (Signed 1:40 PM Chicago)
fields: The new clearinghouse files its framework for identifying and managing enterprise risk — the filing PDF carries a digital-signature timestamp of 1:40:23 PM Central. One of the rare filings in this whole record with an exact moment attached.

rows.title: SEC Approves Customer Cross-Margining in the Treasury Market (FICC-CME)
fields: Accelerated approval plus an exemptive order let customer positions at FICC and CME margin against each other — one collateral pool across Treasuries and futures. Followed June 30 by a joint SEC-CFTC request for comment on going further: the two market cops designing unified margin, the precondition for collateral that moves as tokens.
cross-margining, FICC, CME, Treasury market, collateral

rows.title: DTCC and CME Announce End-User Cross-Margining Approvals
fields: The incumbent and its newest rival jointly announce regulatory approvals to extend cross-margining to eligible end-user clients. Competitor and partner at once — the mesh, not the tournament.

rows.title: SEC Staff Letter: HQLAx DLT Collateral Platform Cleared for US Firms
fields: The second tokenization authorization to travel by staff letter, filed in the same Clearing Agencies drawer as the DTC letter: US broker-dealers and banks may settle securities-financing trades as 'digital collateral records' on the HQLAx distributed ledger with Clearstream custody — capped at 15 US firms, $25B daily, 36 months. Collateral that changes hands as ledger entries, not deliveries. The rule-by-letter pattern is now a pattern.
HQLAx, tokenized collateral, no-action letter, Clearstream, DLT

rows.title: DTCC Sets Tokenization Timeline: July 2026 Pilot, October 2026 Launch
fields: DTCC announces first live tokenized trades of stocks, ETFs and Treasuries in a limited production pilot beginning July 2026 — this month — with full launch in October, and a 50-plus-firm working group seating BlackRock, Goldman, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo beside Circle, Ondo, Ripple, Anchorage and Kraken. TradFi and crypto at one table, inside the settlement monopoly.
DTCC, tokenization, pilot, BlackRock, Circle, Ripple

rows.title: DTCC Plans DTC-Custodied Assets on the Stellar Public Blockchain (H1 2027)
fields: DTCC says DTC-custodied assets are slated to become available on the Stellar network in the first half of 2027, as part of a plan to connect its tokenization service to several public networks.

rows.title: SEC Approves CMESC's Enterprise-Risk Framework
fields: The second Treasury clearinghouse's risk constitution is approved. The rulebook stack is nearly complete; what's missing is the launch date, which has quietly slid from Q2 to 'later in 2026.'

rows.title: SEC Approves NSCC's Extended Clearing Hours (SR-NSCC-2026-006)
fields: The Commission approves NSCC's rule change to extend its operating hours in support of 24-hour equity trading — the legal beat behind the June 28 go-live. The clearinghouse formally agrees to stop sleeping.
NSCC, extended hours, 24x5, clearing, SEC approval

rows.title: SEC Proposes Rescinding the Reg NMS Trade-Through Rule
fields: The SEC moves to tear out the trade-through rule and the locked/crossed-markets provisions — the 2005 architecture of how stocks must route — citing in part the growth of overnight trading sessions. Market structure being rebuilt for a market that no longer keeps hours.
Reg NMS, trade-through, overnight trading, market structure, SEC

rows.title: NSCC Adds Overnight Risk Slices: the Machine Learns to Watch the Dark
fields: Ahead of the 24x5 launch, NSCC adds 15-minute risk-calculation slices between 3:00 and 5:45 AM Eastern. Risk management moves from the daily batch toward the continuous watch — the different nervous system a market without nights requires.

rows.title: 24X National Exchange: Trading Securities in Tokenized Form (DTC Pilot)
fields: A national securities exchange amends its rules — immediately effective — to trade securities in tokenized form during a DTC pilot program. Tokenized stock stops being a white paper and enters the National Market System, citing the SEC staff's January 2026 Statement on Tokenized Securities.
24X, tokenized securities, DTC pilot, national exchange, SEC

rows.title: DTC Widens What Its Cash Rails May Carry (SR-DTC-2026-008)
fields: An immediately effective settlement-guide amendment recasting the permitted uses of DTC's payment orders as 'typical, sample' rather than exclusive — quietly opening the depository's cash-movement rails to uses not yet named.

rows.title: 8:00 PM Sunday: NSCC's 24x5 Clock Starts Ticking
fields: The precise activation: Sunday, June 28, 8:00 PM Eastern, NSCC's production system begins the 24x5 schedule, running to Friday 8 PM. The CCP guarantee now covers the night. Of everything in this record, the single most exactly-timed birth — the moment the American market day stopped being a natural fact.

rows.title: OCC Reopens Ovation Testing to the Whole Market
fields: External scenario testing reopens through September 4, with parallel testing on production data promised for Q3. The options monopoly's engine swap resumes — a year late, with the rest of the plumbing already moving.

rows.title: NSCC Live With 24x5 Clearing: The US Stock Market No Longer Sleeps
fields: NSCC goes live with round-the-clock equity clearing, Sunday 8 PM ET through Friday 8 PM ET, supporting overnight trading from exchanges and ATSs (rule filing cleared in the Federal Register April 16). US equity clearing now runs through the night — the structural step toward 24x7 dollar-asset markets, and it happened inside this window.

rows.title: The Transfer Agents Say a Token Is Not a Share
fields: The Securities Transfer Association, in a July 1 written submission to the SEC's Crypto Task Force (signed by Peter Duggan), asks that any tokenization exemption, pilot or framework be reserved for issuer-sponsored tokens recorded in the issuer's own ownership records: an issuer-sponsored token is a share; a third-party wrapper is not. The letter also raises DRS and DTC points.

rows.title: SEC Approves Overnight Hours for the Consolidated Tape (CTA/CQ + UTP)
fields: Orders approved June 26 extend the consolidated tape processors' operating hours to cover overnight trading (the CTA/CQ 40th/31st amendments, with the UTP 55th alongside). The official record of the national market system formally stops sleeping — three days after NSCC's clearing did.
consolidated tape, overnight trading, CTA, UTP, SEC

rows.title: DTC Files to End Physical Presentment for Redemptions (SR-DTC-2026-009)
fields: DTC proposes killing paper letters of transmittal for redemption and maturity payments — automated notices instead, implementation by December 31, 2026. Small filing, telling direction: paper leaves the depository the same year the tokens arrive.
DTC, physical presentment, paper, redemptions, dematerialization

rows.title: NSCC Files to Rebuild Its Emergency-Liquidity Math (SR-NSCC-2026-009)
fields: NSCC proposes overhauling the Supplemental Liquidity Deposit — how it sizes the emergency cash it demands from members around peak settlement, the mechanism that broke retail brokers in the GameStop episode. A liquidity-math rewrite filed days after clearing went around-the-clock: the system re-armoring for a market that never closes.
NSCC, supplemental liquidity deposit, GameStop, margin, liquidity

rows.title: OCC Self-Certifies Synthetic-Futures Rules While the Engine Swap Runs
fields: OCC files a CFTC self-certification on synthetic futures — the product and risk perimeter keeps moving even while the core platform is mid-replacement. The machine is being rebuilt and re-armed at the same time.

rows.title: The SEC Freezes DTC's Rulebook — the Transfer Agents Draw Blood
fields: The Commission suspends DTC's already-effective rewrite of its Operational Arrangements (one master agreement for ATOP/ASOP corporate-action agents) and institutes disapproval proceedings — on the strength of two Securities Transfer Association letters saying the master agreement shifts risk and liability onto transfer agents, purports to bind issuers without authority, and lets DTC terminate an offer at its own discretion. Order dated Jul 9; FR 2026-14107 published Jul 14. Comments due Aug 4, rebuttals Aug 18. A regulator freezing the depository's rulebook over who bears the risk — six days before the depository's tokenized trades go live.
SR-DTC-2026-007, transfer agents, STA, Operational Arrangements, suspension

rows.title: FICC Proposes Universal Treasury Trade Submission for Central Clearing (SR-FICC-2026-XXX)
fields: FICC proposes requiring all Netting Members to submit every eligible secondary-market U.S. Treasury transaction (cash and repo) for central clearing. The enforcement mechanism for the SEC's 2024 Treasury-clearing mandate — compliance dates Dec 31, 2026 (cash), Jun 30, 2027 (repo). Doc 2026-13827.

rows.title: The Ample-Reserves Machine Can Run Away From Its Operators
fields: Working Paper 26-34, by Philadelphia EVP Roc Armenter: the 'ample' level of reserves is itself a function of liquid deposits, so reaching ample is not the same as being normalized. Feed reserves in, banks create deposits, deposits raise the ample bar, the Desk feeds more in — and at modest deposit persistence the loop goes explosive. His fix is to attenuate the Desk's response and accept small deviations between the effective funds rate and interest on reserves. Context the paper supplies: QT ended December 2025, the balance sheet is over 20 percent of nominal GDP against roughly 5 percent in 2006, and the Desk now runs Reserve Management Purchases under the April 29 2026 implementation note. A sitting Reserve Bank executive publishing that the floor system carries an unpriced instability, two weeks before the meeting.
ample reserves, balance sheet, Reserve Management Purchases, Armenter, floor system, EFFR

rows.title: NSCC's Margin Screw Tightens — the Gap Risk Overhaul Approved
fields: The SEC approves SR-NSCC-2026-008: NSCC will decompose ETFs into their underlying components for the Gap Risk Charge, map leveraged and single-stock ETFs to their unleveraged equivalents, charge bid-ask spreads by ETP sub-category, and recalibrate the Fat Tail Adjustment Factor to real member portfolios. The impact study says the average daily Gap Risk Charge rises about $223M to roughly $950M, with the top 20 accounts up 110–750%. Order Jul 14 (34-105901), FR 2026-14397 published Jul 17. The clearer's collateral bill grows as the clearing mandate closes in.
NSCC, SR-NSCC-2026-008, Gap Risk Charge, margin, clearing fund

rows.title: Dallas Explains Tokenized Deposits to Its District — Blockchain Inside the Bank Charter
fields: A Dallas Fed Economics piece walks readers through commercial banks putting deposits on blockchain structure while keeping them inside the traditional banking framework, settling near-instantaneously. No new rule, no filing — a Reserve Bank teaching the vocabulary. It matters because of who is teaching it: Lorie Logan's bank, the one that runs the Fed's plumbing arguments, telling its district that tokenized bank money is normal banking. The stablecoin gets a statute and a gate; the tokenized deposit gets an explainer and a charter it already has.
tokenized deposits, Dallas Fed, blockchain, bank money, settlement

rows.title: The Ledger Goes Live — DTC's First Tokenized Trades in Production
fields: DTCC converts DTC-held securities into tokens and runs real trades in a DTC production environment over several hours: collateral pledge, securities lending, Treasury/repo DVP, equity DVP and DVD, token transfer, CCP margin. 30+ firms — BlackRock, Goldman, J.P. Morgan (which tokenized QQQ holdings and posted tokenized collateral to CME margin), Vanguard, Circle, Nasdaq, NYSE. Two chains: LFDT Besu (DTCC private) and Canton (public). Assets are digital twins in Participant wallets, convertible both ways. The standing question is answered — the first tokenized trades happened. Full participant-facing service: October 2026.
DTC, tokenization, production, Besu, Canton, October launch

rows.title: Kansas City Builds the Doctrine: Buying Bonds Without Calling It Easing
fields: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City

Research Working Paper 26-05, Andrew Lee Smith and Victor Valcarcel: operationally identical Fed asset purchases do different work depending on why they are made. Purchases for accommodation move yields; purchases for market functioning mainly buy liquidity — cutting dealer inventories and compressing bid-ask spreads when trading turns disorderly. Strip the arithmetic and this is a licence. It gives the Fed a published, respectable way to buy Treasuries in size and say the words 'this is not stimulus.' The paper lands five weeks before Jackson Hole, whose posted theme is financial innovation and payments, at the district bank that hosts it.
LSAP, market functioning, balance sheet, Kansas City Fed, Treasury market, Jackson Hole

rows.title: ICE Clear Credit Quietly Re-Plumbs for Treasuries — SR-ICC-2026-004 Approved
fields: The SEC approves ICE Clear Credit's Operational Risk Management Framework changes (Release 34-105918, order Jul 15; FR Doc. 2026-14525, 91 FR 45306, published Jul 20). Zero comments received. The tell is in the redline: ICC struck the 'CDS'-limiting language from its external-service-provider and technology-control sections so those controls now reach Treasury clearing, and the order cites ICC's Jan 30, 2026 registration for U.S. Treasury CCP services. The competing lane to FICC's monopoly is quietly building its governance before the mandate lands.
ICE Clear Credit, SR-ICC-2026-004, Treasury clearing, operational risk, FICC monopoly

rows.title: 'Headstands and Summervaults' — Peirce Draws the Line Around On-Chain Yield
fields: Commissioner Hester Peirce's statement on crypto vaults and on-chain lending strategies: they may be securities, may make their operators investment companies, may trigger adviser status. 'If you do headstands, backflips, and other gymnastics to read the law so that it does not apply to crypto assets and activities that are well within the scope of the federal securities laws, you will have a painful fall.' She frames it as the sequel to her July 2025 'tokenized securities are still securities' statement and adds that as securities move on-chain, vaults and on-chain lending 'may become mainstream tools for managing investment portfolios.' A warning shot fired in the same month the tokenization exemption was supposed to land.
Peirce, SEC, tokenized securities, on-chain lending, vaults

rows.title: The Market Stops Closing — SEC Opens File 4-913 on 24-Hour Trading
fields: Press Release 2026-69 announces a Sept 17, 2026 roundtable at SEC headquarters on moving toward 24-hour trading in U.S. equity markets, 'including preparations to support overnight trading, operations and resiliency in a 24-hour market,' and opens a public comment file, No. 4-913. Atkins: 'We are moving towards a new day - and night - in the U.S. equity markets.' The clearing and settlement questions of a market that never closes now have a docket to pile up in. Companion to the 24X and NSCC extended-hours track.
SEC, 24-hour trading, File 4-913, Atkins, overnight settlement

rows.title: A Clearing House for Bets on Earnings — Cboe Clear's Amended Application

uncertain: Illustrative teaching entries for role discrimination. Not GAAP or IFRS policy and not a named firm’s actual journal. Named occupants are sourced legal persons or process offices for that seat. Unnamed seats are evidence gaps, not empty markets. A brand, parent, token or chain does not inherit the seat.
Overtake means this office’s proprietary or fiduciary books of the economic object are now someone else’s. Overlap is a different claim, a membership, or a software path hanging off the same rail.

Technical finality, authoritative legal record and cash or redemption remedy are separate endpoints. Proposal, staff position, registration, ownership, partnership, software capability, pilot and production are different facts and clocks.

Group consolidation does not merge the licenses, appointments or duties of the named subsidiaries. A token can be part of an official shareholder register in one product, a representation reconciled to a transfer-agent control book in another, or a secondary layer attached to an incumbent registrar in a third.
The books entries are illustrative teaching entries for working out who plays which role, not any named firm's actual books.
